review: Three things. One, "The Prayer Team Is in the Room" is the most accurate recording of a COGIC prayer service I have heard from anyone outside the tradition, and I have listened for that my whole life. Two, the Hammond registration is right — not approximate, right, and whoever set those drawbars has sat on that bench. Three, and respectfully, I cannot use it Sunday because I do not know what key it is in or what the tempo is, and I am not going to guess in front of a choir. Publish the key and the BPM and this becomes a working tool instead of a listening one. That is the whole gap.
